column1: # Variant characters folded on top of OpenCC's TSCharacters table.
# Each target is the form TSCharacters would produce, so the two tables compose.
# Scope: orthographic variants common in received medical classics, not
# synonyms. A fold only has to be applied consistently to both sides; it does
# not claim the two characters are interchangeable everywhere.

column3: 脉沈; also a surname, harmless when both sides fold
